sub: Spring jar (JDK 21) + MySQL 8.4.7 + Hosted Harness + dist/cli.js from head 846247fa30 · rows read back from qwen_managed_session_journal_tx

## Runs that produced the rows
++ run-managed-agent-server-e2e --model qwen3.8-max      PASS 19 s   toolSideEffect=true  crossTenant=404
++ run-managed-agent-server-e2e --session-failover      PASS 20 s   writerGeneration 1 -> 2
== 44 journal transactions (2 session.create without events) · 48 committed events · 10 of 17 kinds

## parseManagedSessionEvent -> managedEventEnvelopeFrom -> JSON wire -> parseManagedEventEnvelope + schema
++ event.sessionKey == row (tenant_id, workspace_id, session_id)        48/48
++ derive -> parse round trip identical                                 48/48
++ envelope accepted by managed-event-envelope-v1.schema.json           48/48
++ distinct (tenantId, sessionId, sequence) keys                        48/48
++ one-event commits: payloadRef.digest == stored events_digest         36/36
!! multi-event commits (6 tx, 12 events): digest is per event, so a
!!   receiver must recompute it; no stored column carries it            0/12 stored
++ occurredAt <= journal commit time (max lag 40 ms)                    48/48
++ record lines in SQL that contain an absolute path (cwd)              94
++ envelopes that contain an absolute path                              0

## Kinds seen in real rows
   activation.changed 7  checkpoint.committed 9  message.committed 8  model.attempt 8
   message.delta 4  input.accepted 3  wake.requested 3  turn.settled 3  domain.committed 2  tool.intent 1
== not produced by these runs: action.changed tool.receipt context.compacted cancel.requested
==   config.bound lifecycle.changed message.retracted (derivation copies kind, so it is kind-agnostic)
note: Claim holds on real data: the commit path supplies every envelope field today, and keeping the body in SQL really keeps absolute paths (cwd in every record line) off the wire.

title: #13498 · One (tenantId, sessionId, sequence), two different committed facts
sub: Same real Session (qwen3.8-max run): managed_agent_event.sequence_id vs journal commit sequence
blocks:
## real-model-e2e / d506a523-97c1-4023-a33b-38399d4d38ba
  seq  public_event (managed_agent_event)   authoritative_journal (envelope v1 kind)
    1  session.created                      activation.changed
    2  turn.accepted                        input.accepted
    3  environment.provisioning             wake.requested
    4  turn.started                         checkpoint.committed
    5  environment.ready                    message.committed
    6  item.output_text.delta               model.attempt
    7  item.output_text.delta               message.delta
    8  item.output_text.delta               message.delta
    9  item.output_text.delta               model.attempt
   10  turn.completed                       message.committed
!! qwen3.8-max run: 10/10 public sequences reuse a journal key · failover run: 13/13

## What the docs on main say vs what v1 freezes
== parent design 2026-10-04-managed-agent-event-transport.md section 6:
==   "dedups on (tenantId, sessionId, stream, sequence) ... an envelope always names its stream"
==   "one sequence without a source is not an identity"
-- PR envelope key:  (tenantId, sessionId, sequence)        no stream field
-- PR module comment: the notice is "for materialization and cross-node wake"
!! MessageMaterializer reads managed_agent_event by sequence_id (the public stream),
!!   which the v1 kind enum cannot express
++ candidate A: stream = "authoritative_journal" in envelope, key and dedupe (85/85)
note: Today v1 only carries journal kinds, so nothing collides yet. Adding a required field after v1 is frozen is a breaking change, so the stream decision is cheapest now.
